title: Geometry of a class of $\varphi$-minimal surfaces in $\mathbb{H}^2\times \mathbb{R}$
summary: We study a class of $\varphi$-minimal surfaces in the product space $\mathbb{H}^2\times\mathbb{R}$, that is, weighted minimal surfaces whose corresponding weight is determined by a smooth potential function $\varphi$ that depends only on the height coordinate relative to the factor $\mathbb{R}$. Under monotonicity, concavity, and asymptotic conditions on $\varphi$, we obtain a complete classification of connected, properly embedded $\varphi$-minimal surfaces that are invariant under isometries of $\mathbb{H}^2\times\mathbb{R}$ acting trivially on $\mathbb{R}$ and by rotations or parabolic…
